feeds.title: keep it simpElle Blog
feeds.description: 'Keep it simpElle' is Elle Linton's brainchild - a dynamic Health and Fitness Blog exuding inspiration and empowerment. As a UK fitness professional and entrepreneur, Elle's passion for cycling, sweating, and running infuses every post, motivating individuals worldwide to embrace vitality and wellness.

feeds.title: RUNGRL Blog
feeds.description: Thoughtfully curating content and events that share voices and stories, which are changing the existing narrative on what it means to be a runner. Launched in 2018, RUNGRL is a digital media and event platform for Black women that uses running as a vehicle to impact wellness in Black community. Information, inspiration and celebration for the Black woman distance runner.

feeds.title: Black Weight Loss Success
feeds.description: Tips, articles, success stories, recipes, inspirations, exercises, healthy eating and weight loss resources for African American Women.Black Women Losing Weight started with an online Ning community in 2010. They encourage their readers to seek greater wellness and to reach their lifestyle change goal, not just weight loss goals. BWLW also promotes monthly weight loss and health challenges.

feeds.title: Black Health Matters » Fitness
feeds.description: Get lots of upbeat, positive solutions and tips on Fitness, Health, Mind & Body and Nutrition. Black Health Matters provides information about health and well-being from a service-oriented perspective.

feeds.title: Black Girls Run Blog
feeds.description: Black Girl Run encourages and motivates African-American women to practice a healthy lifestyle and serves as a resource for all fitness levels. Their goal is to start a movement to encourage ALL women to get off the couch and get active. Their blog helps you to feel motivated as they share amazing stories, and give updates about events, healthy eating tips, and similar topics.

feeds.title: Massy Arias Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to adopt health and fitness as a lifestyle beyond just losing weight. Join the MA Warrior Tribe Today! Massiel 'Massy' Indhira Arias is the exuberant Certified Personal Trainer, formerly known as Mankofit, who is changing lives and inspiring a new generation of trainers. Born in the Dominican Republic, Massy has been an American resident since the age of 14 and currently resides and trains out of Los Angeles, California.

feeds.title: A Black Girl's Guide To Weight Loss
feeds.description: Erika shares story of her early weight loss adventures, ups and downs of her own experiences and everything she's learned along the way to make her successes possible through A Black Girl's Guide to Weight Loss. She is a wife and mother of two who has gone from couch potato to NASM-certified trainer, with specialties in weight loss, women's fitness, and nutrition.
